[Section] Related Work ::: Benchmark evaluation in NLP
[source_id=78] Beyond MRC, efforts similar to ours that pursue the goal of analysing the evaluation of established datasets exist in Natural Language Inference BIBREF13, BIBREF12. Their analyses reveal the existence of biases in training and evaluation data that can be approximated with simple majority-based heuristics. Because of these biases, trained models fail to extract the semantics that are required for the correct inference. Furthermore, a fair share of work was done to reveal gender bias in coreference resolution datasets and models BIBREF39, BIBREF40, BIBREF41.
